# 飞牛第三方应用精选开发指导意见

## 一、项目概述

### 1.1 项目目标
构建一个仿照飞牛官方应用精选的第三方应用管理系统，实现应用展示、下载、安装等功能，支持多源管理和自动发现。

### 1.2 技术栈

| 分类 | 技术 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| 前端 | index.cgi + UNIX_SOCKET | 飞牛应用标准前端实现 |
| UI 库 | 飞牛原生样式 | 保持与系统风格一致 |
| 后端 | Go 语言 | 高性能、跨平台 |
| 文件处理 | 标准库 / zipfile | 解析 FPK 文件 |
| 存储 | JSON 文件 | 缓存和配置管理 |

## 三、前端实现

### 3.1 index.cgi 实现

```bash
#!/bin/bash

BASE_PATH="/var/apps/fn-appcentreThirdParty/target/www"\nBACKEND_UNIX_SOCKET="${BACKEND_UNIX_SOCKET:-${TRIM_PKGVAR:-/var/apps/fn-appcentreThirdParty/var}/appcentre.sock}"\nBACKEND_CONNECT_TIMEOUT="${BACKEND_CONNECT_TIMEOUT:-5}"\nBACKEND_MAX_TIME="${BACKEND_MAX_TIME:-300}"\n\nREQUEST_METHOD="${REQUEST_METHOD:-GET}"\nREQUEST_URI="${REQUEST_URI:-/}"\n\nBODY_TMP=""\nHDR_TMP=""\nOUT_BODY=""\n\ncleanup() {\n    rm -f "$BODY_TMP" "$HDR_TMP" "$OUT_BODY" 2>/dev/null\n}\ntrap cleanup EXIT\n\ntrim_header_value() {\n    local value="$1"\n    value="${value#*:}"\n    value="${value#"${value%%[![:space:]]*}"}"\n    printf '%s' "${value%$'\r'}"\n}\n\ncreate_temp_file() {\n    mktemp 2>/dev/null || return 1\n}\n\nis_path_traversal() {\n    case "$1" in\n        ../*|*/../*|*/..|..) return 0 ;;\n    esac\n    return 1\n}\n\ndetect_mime() {\n    local file_path="$1"\n    local ext="${file_path##*.}"\n    ext="$(printf '%s' "$ext" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"\n    case "$ext" in\n        html|htm) printf '%s' "text/html; charset=utf-8" ;;\n        css) printf '%s' "text/css; charset=utf-8" ;;\n        js) printf '%s' "application/javascript; charset=utf-8" ;;\n        json) printf '%s' "application/json; charset=utf-8" ;;\n        png) printf '%s' "image/png" ;;\n        *) printf '%s' "application/octet-stream" ;;\n    esac\n}\n\nresolve_rel_path() {\n    local uri_no_query="$REQUEST_URI"\n    uri_no_query="${uri_no_query%%\?*}"\n    local rel="/"\n\n    case "$uri_no_query" in\n        *index.cgi*)\n            rel="${uri_no_query#*index.cgi}"\n            ;;\n    esac\n\n    if [ -z "$rel" ] || [ "$rel" = "/" ]; then\n        rel="/index.html"\n    fi\n\n    if [ "${rel#/}" = "$rel" ]; then\n        rel="/$rel"\n    fi\n\n    case "$rel" in\n        */) rel="${rel}index.html" ;;\n    esac\n\n    printf '%s' "$rel"\n}\n\nbuild_backend_url() {\n    local rel_path="$1"\n    local query_suffix=""\n    if [ -n "${QUERY_STRING:-}" ]; then\n        query_suffix="?${QUERY_STRING}"\n    fi\n    printf '%s' "http://localhost${rel_path}${query_suffix}"\n}\n\nforward_request_headers() {\n    local curl_args=()\n    local header_name value\n\n    for env_name in \\n        CONTENT_TYPE \\n        HTTP_AUTHORIZATION \\n        HTTP_ACCEPT \\n        HTTP_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE \\n        HTTP_COOKIE \\n        HTTP_USER_AGENT \\n        HTTP_REFERER\n    do\n        value="${!env_name}"\n        [ -n "$value" ] || continue\n\n        case "$env_name" in\n            CONTENT_TYPE) header_name="Content-Type" ;;\n            HTTP_AUTHORIZATION) header_name="Authorization" ;;\n            HTTP_ACCEPT) header_name="Accept" ;;\n            HTTP_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE) header_name="Accept-Language" ;;\n            HTTP_COOKIE) header_name="Cookie" ;;\n            HTTP_USER_AGENT) header_name="User-Agent" ;;\n            HTTP_REFERER) header_name="Referer" ;;\n            *) continue ;;\n        esac\n        curl_args+=(-H "${header_name}: ${value}")\n    done\n\n    printf '%s\n' "${curl_args[@]}"\n}\n\nparse_backend_response() {\n    local line\n    status_code="502"\n    resp_ct="application/octet-stream"\n    backend_headers=()\n\n    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do\n        line="${line%$'\r'}"\n        [ -n "$line" ] || continue\n\n        case "$line" in\n            HTTP/*)\n                set -- $line\n                status_code="${2:-502}"\n                ;;\n            [Cc]ontent-[Tt]ype:*)\n                resp_ct="$(trim_header_value "$line")"\n                ;;\n            [Ss]et-[Cc]ookie:*|[Cc]ache-[Cc]ontrol:*|[Ee]xpires:*|[Aa]ccess-[Cc]ontrol-[Aa]llow-*|[Ll]ocation:*)\n                backend_headers+=("$line")\n                ;;\n        esac\n    done\n}\n\nprint_cgi_header() {\n    printf '%s\r\n' "$1"\n}\n\nsend_text_response() {\n    local status="$1"\n    local body="${2:-}"\n    print_cgi_header "Status: $status"\n    print_cgi_header "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8"\n    print_cgi_header "Content-Length: ${#body}"\n    print_cgi_header ""\n    [ "$REQUEST_METHOD" != "HEAD" ] && [ -n "$body" ] && printf '%s' "$body"\n    exit 0\n}\n\nproxy_api_request() {\n    local curl_exit body_size\n\n    HDR_TMP="$(create_temp_file)" || send_text_response "500 Internal Server Error" "500 Internal Server Error"\n    OUT_BODY="$(create_temp_file)" || send_text_response "500 Internal Server Error" "500 Internal Server Error"\n\n    local curl_args=(\n        -sS\n        --http1.1\n        --connect-timeout "$BACKEND_CONNECT_TIMEOUT"\n        --max-time "$BACKEND_MAX_TIME"\n        -D "$HDR_TMP"\n        -o "$OUT_BODY"\n        -X "$REQUEST_METHOD"\n        -H "Connection: close"\n    )\n\n    while IFS= read -r header; do\n        [ -n "$header" ] && curl_args+=(-H "$header")\n    done < <(forward_request_headers)\n\n    if [ "$REQUEST_METHOD" = "POST" ] || [ "$REQUEST_METHOD" = "PUT" ] || [ "$REQUEST_METHOD" = "PATCH" ] || [ "$REQUEST_METHOD" = "DELETE" ]; then\n        if [ -n "${CONTENT_LENGTH:-}" ] && [ "${CONTENT_LENGTH:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then\n            BODY_TMP="$(create_temp_file)" || send_text_response "500 Internal Server Error" "500 Internal Server Error"\n            dd bs=1 count="$CONTENT_LENGTH" of="$BODY_TMP" 2>/dev/null || cat >"$BODY_TMP"\n            [ -n "$BODY_TMP" ] && [ -f "$BODY_TMP" ] && curl_args+=(--data-binary "@$BODY_TMP")\n        fi\n    fi\n\n    local backend_url\n    backend_url="$(build_backend_url "$REL_PATH")"\n\n    if [ -n "$BACKEND_UNIX_SOCKET" ] && [ -S "$BACKEND_UNIX_SOCKET" ]; then\n        curl --unix-socket "$BACKEND_UNIX_SOCKET" "${curl_args[@]}" "$backend_url"\n        curl_exit=$?\n    else\n        curl "${curl_args[@]}" "$backend_url"\n        curl_exit=$?\n    fi\n\n    if [ "$curl_exit" -ne 0 ]; then\n        if [ "$curl_exit" -eq 28 ]; then\n            send_text_response "504 Gateway Timeout" "504 Gateway Timeout: Backend request timed out"\n        fi\n        send_text_response "502 Bad Gateway" "502 Bad Gateway: Backend unavailable"\n    fi\n\n    parse_backend_response < "$HDR_TMP"\n\n    print_cgi_header "Status: $status_code"\n    print_cgi_header "Content-Type: $resp_ct"\n    for header in "${backend_headers[@]}"; do\n        print_cgi_header "$header"\n    done\n\n    if [ -f "$OUT_BODY" ]; then\n        body_size="$(wc -c < "$OUT_BODY" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"\n        print_cgi_header "Content-Length: $body_size"\n    fi\n    print_cgi_header ""\n\n    if [ "$REQUEST_METHOD" != "HEAD" ] && [ -f "$OUT_BODY" ]; then\n        cat "$OUT_BODY"\n    fi\n    exit 0\n}\n\nserve_static_file() {\n    local target_file mime size last_mod mtime ims_epoch\n\n    if is_path_traversal "${REL_PATH#/}"; then\n        send_text_response "400 Bad Request" "Bad Request: Path traversal detected"\n    fi\n\n    target_file="${BASE_PATH}${REL_PATH}"\n\n    if [ ! -f "$target_file" ] || [ ! -r "$target_file" ]; then\n        send_text_response "404 Not Found" "404 Not Found: ${REL_PATH}"\n    fi\n\n    mime="$(detect_mime "$target_file")"\n    size="$(wc -c < "$target_file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"\n    mtime=0\n    if stat -c %Y "$target_file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n        mtime="$(stat -c %Y "$target_file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"\n    fi\n\n    last_mod=""\n    if [ "$mtime" -gt 0 ]; then\n        last_mod="$(date -u -d "@$mtime" +"%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S GMT" 2>/dev/null || date -u -r "$target_file" +"%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S GMT" 2>/dev/null || echo "")"\n    fi\n\n    if [ -n "${HTTP_IF_MODIFIED_SINCE:-}" ] && [ -n "$last_mod" ]; then\n        ims_epoch="$(date -d "$HTTP_IF_MODIFIED_SINCE" +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"\n        if [ "$mtime" -gt 0 ] && [ "$ims_epoch" -ge "$mtime" ]; then\n            print_cgi_header "Status: 304 Not Modified"\n            print_cgi_header ""\n            exit 0\n        fi\n    fi\n\n    print_cgi_header "Content-Type: $mime"\n    print_cgi_header "Content-Length: $size"\n    [ -n "$last_mod" ] && print_cgi_header "Last-Modified: $last_mod"\n    print_cgi_header ""\n\n    if [ "$REQUEST_METHOD" != "HEAD" ]; then\n        cat "$target_file"\n    fi\n    exit 0\n}\n\nREL_PATH="$(resolve_rel_path)"\n\ncase "$REL_PATH" in\n    /api | /api/*)\n        proxy_api_request\n        ;;\n    *)\n        serve_static_file\n        ;;\nesac
```

### 3.2 前端页面实现

#### index.html

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>应用精选</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">
</head>
<body>
    <div class="app-container">
        <header class="app-header">
            <h1>第三方应用中心</h1>
            <div class="search-box">
                <input type="text" id="searchInput" placeholder="搜索应用...">
                <button id="searchBtn">搜索</button>
            </div>
        </header>
        
        <nav class="app-nav">
            <ul>
                <li class="active"><a href="#">全部应用</a></li>
                <li><a href="#">工具</a></li>
                <li><a href="#">媒体</a></li>
                <li><a href="#">网络</a></li>
                <li><a href="#" id="sourceManager">源管理</a></li>
            </ul>
        </nav>
        
        <main class="app-content">
            <div class="app-grid" id="appGrid">
                <!-- 应用卡片将通过 JavaScript 动态生成 -->
            </div>
        </main>
        
        <div class="app-detail" id="appDetail">
            <!-- 应用详情将通过 JavaScript 动态生成 -->
        </div>
        
        <div class="source-manager" id="sourceManagerDialog">
            <!-- 源管理对话框将通过 JavaScript 动态生成 -->
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

#### app.js

```javascript
// 应用中心前端逻辑
const API_BASE = '/api';

// 应用列表
async function loadApps() {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/apps`);
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.code === 0) {
            renderAppGrid(data.data.apps);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('加载应用失败:', error);
    }
}

// 渲染应用网格
function renderAppGrid(apps) {
    const appGrid = document.getElementById('appGrid');
    appGrid.innerHTML = '';
    
    apps.forEach(app => {
        const appCard = document.createElement('div');
        appCard.className = 'app-card';
        appCard.innerHTML = `
            <div class="app-icon">
                <img src="${app.icon}" alt="${app.name}">
            </div>
            <h3 class="app-name">${app.name}</h3>
            <p class="app-desc">${app.description}</p>
            <div class="app-info">
                <span class="app-version">${app.version}</span>
                <span class="app-size">${app.size} MB</span>
            </div>
            <button class="app-download" data-app-id="${app.id}">下载</button>
        `;
        appGrid.appendChild(appCard);
    });
    
    // 添加下载按钮事件
    document.querySelectorAll('.app-download').forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener('click', async function() {
            const appId = this.dataset.appId;
            await downloadApp(appId);
        });
    });
}

// 下载应用
async function downloadApp(appId) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/apps/${appId}`);
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.code === 0) {
            const downloadUrl = data.data.download_url;
            window.location.href = downloadUrl;
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('下载应用失败:', error);
    }
}

// 加载源列表
async function loadSources() {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/sources`);
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.code === 0) {
            renderSourceManager(data.data.sources);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('加载源列表失败:', error);
    }
}

// 渲染源管理
function renderSourceManager(sources) {
    const sourceManager = document.getElementById('sourceManagerDialog');
    sourceManager.innerHTML = `
        <div class="dialog-header">
            <h2>源管理</h2>
            <button id="closeSourceManager">关闭</button>
        </div>
        <div class="dialog-content">
            <button id="addSourceBtn">添加源</button>
            <table class="source-table">
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th>名称</th>
                        <th>地址</th>
                        <th>状态</th>
                        <th>应用数量</th>
                        <th>操作</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                    ${sources.map(source => `
                        <tr>
                            <td>${source.name}</td>
                            <td>${source.url}</td>
                            <td>${source.enabled ? '启用' : '禁用'}</td>
                            <td>${source.app_count}</td>
                            <td>
                                <button class="sync-source" data-source-id="${source.id}">同步</button>
                                <button class="delete-source" data-source-id="${source.id}">删除</button>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                    `).join('')}
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>
    `;
    
    // 添加事件监听
    document.getElementById('closeSourceManager').addEventListener('click', function() {
        sourceManager.style.display = 'none';
    });
    
    document.getElementById('addSourceBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
        // 显示添加源对话框
        showAddSourceDialog();
    });
    
    document.querySelectorAll('.sync-source').forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener('click', async function() {
            const sourceId = this.dataset.sourceId;
            await syncSource(sourceId);
        });
    });
    
    document.querySelectorAll('.delete-source').forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener('click', async function() {
            const sourceId = this.dataset.sourceId;
            await deleteSource(sourceId);
        });
    });
}

// 显示添加源对话框
function showAddSourceDialog() {
    const dialog = document.createElement('div');
    dialog.className = 'dialog';
    dialog.innerHTML = `
        <div class="dialog-content">
            <h3>添加源</h3>
            <input type="text" id="sourceName" placeholder="源名称">
            <input type="text" id="sourceUrl" placeholder="源地址 (例如: http://fpk.example.com:18088)">
            <div class="dialog-buttons">
                <button id="confirmAddSource">确定</button>
                <button id="cancelAddSource">取消</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
    document.body.appendChild(dialog);
    
    document.getElementById('confirmAddSource').addEventListener('click', async function() {
        const name = document.getElementById('sourceName').value;
        const url = document.getElementById('sourceUrl').value;
        await addSource(name, url);
        document.body.removeChild(dialog);
    });
    
    document.getElementById('cancelAddSource').addEventListener('click', function() {
        document.body.removeChild(dialog);
    });
}

// 添加源
async function addSource(name, url) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/sources`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ name, url })
        });
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.code === 0) {
            alert('添加源成功');
            loadSources();
        } else {
            alert('添加源失败: ' + data.message);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('添加源失败:', error);
        alert('添加源失败');
    }
}

// 同步源
async function syncSource(sourceId) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/sources/${sourceId}/sync`, {
            method: 'POST'
        });
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.code === 0) {
            alert('同步成功');
            loadSources();
        } else {
            alert('同步失败: ' + data.message);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('同步源失败:', error);
        alert('同步源失败');
    }
}

// 删除源
async function deleteSource(sourceId) {
    if (confirm('确定要删除此源吗？')) {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/sources/${sourceId}`, {
                method: 'DELETE'
            });
            const data = await response.json();
            if (data.code === 0) {
                alert('删除源成功');
                loadSources();
            } else {
                alert('删除源失败: ' + data.message);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('删除源失败:', error);
            alert('删除源失败');
        }
    }
}

// 初始化
function init() {
    // 加载应用列表
    loadApps();
    
    // 搜索功能
    document.getElementById('searchBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
        const keyword = document.getElementById('searchInput').value;
        if (keyword) {
            searchApps(keyword);
        } else {
            loadApps();
        }
    });
    
    // 源管理按钮
    document.getElementById('sourceManager').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const sourceManager = document.getElementById('sourceManagerDialog');
        sourceManager.style.display = 'block';
        loadSources();
    });
}

// 搜索应用
async function searchApps(keyword) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/apps?keyword=${encodeURIComponent(keyword)}`);
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.code === 0) {
            renderAppGrid(data.data.apps);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('搜索应用失败:', error);
    }
}

// 页面加载完成后初始化
window.onload = init;
```

## 四、后端实现

### 4.1 主服务入口 (main.go)

```go
package main

import (
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/fcgi"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

var (
	unixSocket = flag.String("unix-socket", "/var/apps/fn-appcentreThirdParty/var/appcentre.sock", "Unix socket path")
	port       = flag.Int("port", 18088, "HTTP port")
)

func main() {
	flag.Parse()

	// 初始化配置
	initConfig()

	// 初始化路由
	r := setupRouter()

	// 确保目录存在
	ensureDirs()

	// 启动服务
	if *unixSocket != "" {
		// 使用 Unix socket
		if err := os.RemoveAll(*unixSocket); err != nil {
			log.Fatalf("Failed to remove old socket: %v", err)
		}

		listener, err := net.Listen("unix", *unixSocket)
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatalf("Failed to create Unix socket: %v", err)
		}
		defer listener.Close()

		if err := os.Chmod(*unixSocket, 0666); err != nil {
			log.Fatalf("Failed to set socket permissions: %v", err)
		}

		log.Printf("Starting server on Unix socket: %s", *unixSocket)
		if err := http.Serve(listener, r); err != nil {
			log.Fatalf("Failed to start server: %v", err)
		}
	} else {
		// 使用 HTTP 端口
		serverAddr := fmt.Sprintf(":%d", *port)
		log.Printf("Starting server on %s", serverAddr)
		if err := r.Run(serverAddr); err != nil {
			log.Fatalf("Failed to start server: %v", err)
		}
	}
}

func setupRouter() *gin.Engine {
	r := gin.Default()

	// 注册 API 路由
	registerRoutes(r)

	// 静态文件服务
	r.Static("/download", "./download")
	r.Static("/AppStore", "./AppStore")

	return r
}

func initConfig() {
	// 初始化配置
}

func ensureDirs() {
	// 确保必要的目录存在
	dirs := []string{
		"./AppStore",
		"./download",
		"./var",
	}

	for _, dir := range dirs {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
			log.Printf("Failed to create directory %s: %v", dir, err)
		}
	}
}

func registerRoutes(r *gin.Engine) {
	api := r.Group("/api")
	{
		// 应用相关接口
		api.GET("/apps", getApps)
		api.GET("/apps/:id", getAppDetail)
		api.GET("/apps/:id/icon", getAppIcon)

		// 源管理接口
		api.GET("/sources", getSources)
		api.POST("/sources", addSource)
		api.DELETE("/sources/:id", deleteSource)
		api.POST("/sources/:id/sync", syncSource)
	}
}
```

### 4.4 FPK 解析器实现 (parser/fpk_parser.go)

```go
package parser

import (
	"archive/zip"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

// FPKParser FPK 文件解析器
type FPKParser struct {}

// NewFPKParser 创建 FPK 解析器
func NewFPKParser() *FPKParser {
	return &FPKParser{}
}

// Parse 解析 FPK 文件
func (p *FPKParser) Parse(fpkPath string) (*AppInfo, error) {
	// 打开 FPK 文件
	r, err := zip.OpenReader(fpkPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer r.Close()

	// 创建临时目录
	tempDir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "fpk_")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer os.RemoveAll(tempDir)

	// 解压 FPK 文件
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			continue
		}

		destPath := filepath.Join(tempDir, f.Name)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		destFile, err := os.Create(destPath)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		srcFile, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			destFile.Close()
			return nil, err
		}

		_, err = io.Copy(destFile, srcFile)
		srcFile.Close()
		destFile.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	// 解析 manifest 文件
	manifestPath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "manifest")
	if _, err := os.Stat(manifestPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return nil, err
	}

	manifestParser := NewManifestParser()
	appInfo, err := manifestParser.Parse(manifestPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// 提取图标
	iconPath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "ICON.PNG")
	if _, err := os.Stat(iconPath); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		// 复制图标到 AppStore 目录
		iconDest := filepath.Join("AppStore", appInfo.ID, "ICON.PNG")
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(iconDest), 0755); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		iconData, err := os.ReadFile(iconPath)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		if err := os.WriteFile(iconDest, iconData, 0644); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		appInfo.Icon = "/AppStore/" + appInfo.ID + "/ICON.PNG"
	}

	return appInfo, nil
}

// AppInfo 应用信息
type AppInfo struct {
	ID          string   `json:"id"`
	Name        string   `json:"name"`
	Description string   `json:"description"`
	Version     string   `json:"version"`
	Platform    string   `json:"platform"`
	Categories  []string `json:"categories"`
	Author      string   `json:"author"`
	Publisher   string   `json:"publisher"`
	Size        string   `json:"size"`
	Icon        string   `json:"icon"`
	DownloadURL string   `json:"download_url"`
	Changelog   string   `json:"changelog"`
}
```

### 4.5 Manifest 解析器实现 (parser/manifest_parser.go)

```go
package parser

import (
	"bufio"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

// ManifestParser Manifest 文件解析器
type ManifestParser struct {}

// NewManifestParser 创建 Manifest 解析器
func NewManifestParser() *ManifestParser {
	return &ManifestParser{}
}

// Parse 解析 Manifest 文件
func (p *ManifestParser) Parse(manifestPath string) (*AppInfo, error) {
	file, err := os.Open(manifestPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	appInfo := &AppInfo{}
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(file)

	for scanner.Scan() {
		line := scanner.Text()
		if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
			continue
		}

		parts := strings.SplitN(line, "=", 2)
		if len(parts) != 2 {
			continue
		}

		key := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
		value := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])

		switch key {
		case "appname":
			appInfo.ID = value
		case "display_name":
			appInfo.Name = value
		case "desc":
			appInfo.Description = value
		case "version":
			appInfo.Version = value
		case "platform":
			appInfo.Platform = value
		case "labels":
			appInfo.Categories = strings.Split(value, ",")
		case "maintainer":
			appInfo.Author = value
		case "distributor":
			appInfo.Publisher = value
		case "size":
			appInfo.Size = value
		case "changelog":
			appInfo.Changelog = value
		}
	}

	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return appInfo, nil
}
```

### 4.6 源管理器实现 (manager/source_manager.go)

```go
package manager

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"io/ioutil"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"
)

// SourceManager 源管理器
type SourceManager struct {
	ConfigPath string
	Sources    []Source
}

// Source 源模型
type Source struct {
	ID          string    `json:"id"`
	Name        string    `json:"name"`
	URL         string    `json:"url"`
	Enabled     bool      `json:"enabled"`
	AutoUpdate  bool      `json:"auto_update"`
	LastSync    time.Time `json:"last_sync"`
	AppCount    int       `json:"app_count"`
	Local       bool      `json:"local"`
}

// NewSourceManager 创建源管理器
func NewSourceManager(configPath string) *SourceManager {
	return &SourceManager{
		ConfigPath: configPath,
		Sources:    []Source{},
	}
}

// Load 加载源配置
func (m *SourceManager) Load() error {
	if _, err := os.Stat(m.ConfigPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
		// 配置文件不存在，使用默认配置
		m.Sources = []Source{
			{
				ID:         "official",
				Name:       "官方源",
				URL:        "http://fpk.example.com:18088",
				Enabled:    true,
				AutoUpdate: true,
				Local:      false,
			},
		}
		return m.Save()
	}

	data, err := ioutil.ReadFile(m.ConfigPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return json.Unmarshal(data, &m.Sources)
}

// Save 保存源配置
func (m *SourceManager) Save() error {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(m.ConfigPath), 0755); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(m.Sources, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return ioutil.WriteFile(m.ConfigPath, data, 0644)
}

// Add 添加源
func (m *SourceManager) Add(source Source) error {
	// 生成唯一ID
	source.ID = generateSourceID(source.Name)
	source.LastSync = time.Now()
	m.Sources = append(m.Sources, source)
	return m.Save()
}

// Remove 删除源
func (m *SourceManager) Remove(id string) error {
	for i, source := range m.Sources {
		if source.ID == id {
			m.Sources = append(m.Sources[:i], m.Sources[i+1:]...)
			return m.Save()
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Sync 同步源
func (m *SourceManager) Sync(id string) error {
	// 实现源同步逻辑
	for i, source := range m.Sources {
		if source.ID == id {
			m.Sources[i].LastSync = time.Now()
			// 同步应用数据
			return m.Save()
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// DiscoverLocalSources 发现本地源
func (m *SourceManager) DiscoverLocalSources() error {
	downloadDir := "./download"
	if _, err := os.Stat(downloadDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return nil
	}

	entries, err := os.ReadDir(downloadDir)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	for _, entry := range entries {
		if !entry.IsDir() {
			continue
		}

		sourceDir := filepath.Join(downloadDir, entry.Name())
		fnpackPath := filepath.Join(sourceDir, "fnpack.json")
		if _, err := os.Stat(fnpackPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}

		// 检查是否已存在
		exists := false
		for _, source := range m.Sources {
			if source.ID == entry.Name() && source.Local {
				exists = true
				break
			}
		}

		if !exists {
			source := Source{
				ID:         entry.Name(),
				Name:       entry.Name(),
				URL:        "http://localhost:18088/download/" + entry.Name(),
				Enabled:    true,
				AutoUpdate: true,
				LastSync:   time.Now(),
				Local:      true,
			}
			m.Sources = append(m.Sources, source)
		}
	}

	return m.Save()
}

// generateSourceID 生成源ID
func generateSourceID(name string) string {
	// 生成唯一ID
	return "source_" + time.Now().Format("20060102150405")
}
```

## 五、构建与部署

### 5.1 构建脚本 (build.bat)

```batch
@echo off

echo 开始构建第三方应用中心...

REM 设置Go环境变量
set GO111MODULE=on
set GOPROXY=https://goproxy.io,direct

REM 创建输出目录
if not exist "output" mkdir output

REM 构建后端服务
echo 构建后端服务...
go build -o output/appcentre.exe ./app/server
if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
    echo 构建后端失败！
    exit /b 1
)

echo 构建后端成功！

REM 复制前端文件
echo 复制前端文件...
if not exist "output/app" mkdir "output/app"
if not exist "output/app/ui" mkdir "output/app/ui"
if not exist "output/app/www" mkdir "output/app/www"

copy "app/ui/index.cgi" "output/app/ui/"
if exist "app/ui/images" (
    xcopy "app/ui/images" "output/app/ui/images" /s /e
)

if exist "app/www" (
    xcopy "app/www" "output/app/www" /s /e
)

REM 复制配置文件
echo 复制配置文件...
if exist "config" (
    xcopy "config" "output/config" /s /e
)

if exist "wizard" (
    xcopy "wizard" "output/wizard" /s /e
)

if exist "cmd" (
    xcopy "cmd" "output/cmd" /s /e
)

REM 复制manifest文件
if exist "manifest" (
    copy "manifest" "output/"
)

echo 构建完成！产物位于 output 目录

pause
```

### 5.3 主服务管理脚本 (cmd/main)

```bash
#!/bin/bash

case $1 in
start)
    # 启动应用中心服务
    echo "启动第三方应用中心服务..."
    
    # 检查 Unix socket 目录
    if [ ! -d "$TRIM_PKGVAR" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$TRIM_PKGVAR"
    fi
    
    # 启动后端服务
    "$TRIM_APPDEST/appcentre" --unix-socket "$TRIM_PKGVAR/appcentre.sock" &
    
    echo "第三方应用中心服务启动成功！"
    exit 0
    ;;
stop)
    # 停止应用中心服务
    echo "停止第三方应用中心服务..."
    
    # 查找并终止进程
    PID=$(ps aux | grep "appcentre" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}')
    if [ -n "$PID" ]; then
        kill $PID
        echo "服务已停止"
    else
        echo "服务未运行"
    fi
    
    exit 0
    ;;
status)
    # 检查应用中心服务状态
    PID=$(ps aux | grep "appcentre" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}')
    if [ -n "$PID" ]; then
        echo "服务正在运行"
        exit 0
    else
        echo "服务未运行"
        exit 3
    fi
    ;;
*)
    echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|status}"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
```

## 六、开发流程

### 6.1 开发环境搭建

1. **安装 Go 环境**
   - 下载并安装 Go 1.18+ 版本
   - 设置 GOPATH 和 GOROOT 环境变量

2. **安装依赖**
   ```bash
   go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin
   go get github.com/gin-contrib/cors
   ```

3. **前端开发**
   - 编辑 `app/www` 目录下的 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 文件
   - 编辑 `app/ui/index.cgi` 配置文件

4. **后端开发**
   - 编辑 `app/server` 目录下的 Go 代码
   - 实现 API 接口和核心功能

### 6.2 构建与测试

1. **构建应用**
   ```bash
   build.bat
   ```

2. **本地测试**
   ```bash
   # 启动后端服务
   go run app/server/main.go --port 18088
   
   # 访问前端
   http://localhost:18088
   ```

3. **打包测试**
   - 使用 fnpack.exe 打包应用
   - 在飞牛系统中安装测试

### 6.3 调试技巧

1. **日志调试**
   - 在后端代码中添加日志输出
   - 使用 `log.Printf()` 打印调试信息

2. **网络调试**
   - 使用 curl 测试 API 接口
   - 使用浏览器开发者工具调试前端

3. **文件系统调试**
   - 检查 AppStore 和 download 目录结构
   - 验证 FPK 文件解析结果

---

## 七、安全考虑

1. **输入验证**
   - 验证源地址格式
   - 验证文件名和路径

2. **文件安全**
   - 限制文件访问路径
   - 验证 FPK 文件完整性

3. **网络安全**
   - 限制 API 访问频率
   - 防止跨站请求伪造

4. **权限管理**
   - 设置正确的文件权限
   - 限制敏感操作的访问

---

## 八、总结

本开发指导意见提供了一个完整的第三方应用中心实现方案，包括：

1. **标准的飞牛应用结构**，遵循飞牛应用开发规范
2. **前端使用 index.cgi + UNIX_SOCKET**，与飞牛系统完美集成
3. **后端使用 Go 语言**，高性能、跨平台
4. **完整的 FPK 解析功能**，支持应用元信息提取
5. **灵活的源管理机制**，支持多源和自动发现
6. **标准化的 API 接口**，便于扩展和集成

该方案完全符合飞牛应用的开发规范，可以直接作为开发指导文档使用。开发者可以根据实际需求进行适当调整和扩展。
